limits_of_evidence: Pass-event counts include named subtests; they are not distinct production workloads.
Unit/HTTP gates use actual durable files and production transition validation with an in-process broker/executor fixture.
The actual-child gate uses the real sandboxed query worker. Its process-kill cases use a synced disk-backed broker test double, not real JetStream.
The configured-execution gate opens real cgroup-v2 containment and probes enforcement during startup; it validates constructor binding and does not run SQL or exercise broker failover.
Committed local files remain unreadable after an interrupted Stored publication; restarted workers neither adopt nor replay the abandoned execution. Unexpired reservations remain charged.

This receipt does not establish public gateway, real broker failover, throughput, capacity, provider compatibility or an exact-final-commit release build; those require their separate acceptance receipts.
